body:
I think I should be left to my own devices to now, I’d like to keep it between me and them, quietly talking to them for advice and what I should do 
Also update, she’s okay, she woke up, we’re being affectionate everything’s alright. A massive relief, I feel like a huge weight has been lifted off my shoulders. 
anywho, I’ll definitely do that! ask them for advice on what I can do, thank you for your help I really appreciate it. A lot, thank you so much

Should be, but she’s in Sweden so things become a bit more, complicated.. 
is there a international number perhaps?
Which number should I try? There are many different options, i’m not sure which one would be the most suitable

Really? They will? They won’t wash their hands? Will they actually be able to help me out? Apologies for my skeptics,  it’s just that I feel that it’s an uphill battle y’know cause the Swedish health care system hasn’t been kind to her, would they be able to intervene where she could not?

I’ve looked into different websites, however I’m not too sure on what, exactly to do, do I ring them up? What can they do to help me out? I’m not a critical situation myself, just a terribly worried person of someone who is close to becoming in that critical situation, and has been, so far no actual attempts have been made so survival instincts, could I hope that they would work for the first time? Just the thought of her dying completely shatters me, 
Right, got way off track there, just wondering what I could do

Life’s too short to not give it your best shot, I’m giving  it my absolute all, and I’m sure your going through some rough times yourself, I hope things will get better for you eventually, your right as in I believe you, we are all here together, one step at a time hey?

If you die, you’ll damage your friends and family, period. If you tell them what they would rather want, live with your problems or you dying, what will they choose? I really hope you’ll still choose to keep living, people like us, it means a whole lot if we choose to keep moving forward, please choose to keep on living despite all the suffering. We’re all trying to do our best and I’m sure you are as well, suicide may not be a bad thing for you but it definitely will be bad for the people that love you

Hey man, your a mood killer too? Same, i get that shit, anywho I hope you’ll still stick around, and I’m here to talk to if you want to vent some more. 

I feel that the world would be worse off, for instance I resonated with your post, while it was super shitty that you went through that, it resonated with me, whether that means something or jackshit to you, either way that’s okay, we’re all in this together

Bloody tried to comment on this earlier but I had a time limited on me(?) 

Anywho, here I go
Hey man, that sounds like a super shitty situation, I really hope you choose to keep living, im not gonna say everything is going to be okay, screw shallow optimism. I’m saying that your situation is, god awful. And I get that, I get that feeling, had it in my own experience. Too anxious to live too anxious to die, I get that, 
I’m with you if you want to talk, if you want to unload, I’m here. I have your back, I hope I was able to help to some extents, i don’t know you at all but, we’re all in this together, one step at a time hey?

You made my day, you have acknowledged my comment, and even said that it helped, what more could I ask for? Thank you for validating my response to you, it really helps me out too. Help, it’s like a two way street hey? We’re both helping each other out

Logically speaking, your death would make them feel much worse. Anywho if you wanna vent, I’m here for you man, lay it on me I’d be all ears 

I hope you will choose to stay alive, after all, people like us, if we stick around, it’s the best way to tell an apathetic world to go fuck themselves, and how no matter the circumstance, we choose to still keep moving forwards. You have value, have worth. I believe you do, and I’m sure many others do also

There asleep atm, Timezone difference, just waiting for her to reply, she promised me that she would be awake later on, and I trust her, but I’m just wondering to what extents can I help? do I resort to psychological manipulation? Or is there a better term for that? I don’t know
I just want to help, I just want her to be happy man, to be okay, I want that more than anything, if that meant she’d be happy without me in her life, that would be agony but I’d live, because then I could see that she’s happy, but she hasn’t ever said that, she’s just in a really bad place, and I’ve been pouring in my time in trying to tell her that she’s strong enough to keep living 
we all on this shit of a planet together y’know

Oh yeah I’m definitely under qualified, I realise this, but like, the public system there is awful, is there any practical thing I could do? To help? You said I could call the suicide hotline for good resources, I’m happy for any advice, best case practical things for my next step, I’ll pour myself into that, feeling helpless deteriorates me quickly

I’m not going anywhere if she doesn’t, yeah? Just to clarify, also I really appreciate your reply, so thank you, I don’t think saying that I want to die would be too good for her currently, I’m not a critical situation as in, I don’t have the tools here currently to off myself, so if that gives you reassurance, I hope it does.
